Piecewise-linear interpolation of independence knot values is an admissible full diagonal and published upper/Bertino splice realizes F_ij simultaneously. Centering and the d=floor/ceil(H_n/n) cutoff prove the 8-residue optimization for all n. Exact finite witnesses at n=3 and 8 and an independent grid enumeration n=2..95, plus large-n centered checks, agree. The entire infinite claim is established analytically, not inferred from experiments. No assumption of smoothness or positive cell masses is made.

originality.rationale: Three highly pertinent open-access primary manuscripts were materially inspected and paired with semantic literature and published-research comparisons. The nearest full-diagonal envelope theorem and its 15/64 independence example are prior contributions invoked transparently; they do not present the finite-knot model, simultaneous finite-table bound, or the n-mod-8 quasi-polynomial.
